name: Urza's Ruinous Blast
oracle_text:
(You may cast a legendary sorcery only if you control a legendary creature or planeswalker.)
Exile all nonland permanents that aren't legendary.
blocked_sentences: (You may cast a legendary sorcery only if you control a legendary creature or planeswalker.)

needs.what: rule 205.4e casting restriction: a spell with both the Legendary supertype and the Sorcery type (and likewise a legendary instant) may be cast only if its caster controls a legendary creature or a legendary planeswalker; the engine's cast-legality check must read the card's supertypes and refuse the cast otherwise. The verification sandbox will also need a legendary creature on player 0's side for such a card, since the position's only legend is the opponent's
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The engine reads Legendary only for the legend rule, copy characteristics and deck construction; nothing in casting checks it, so supertypes: ["Legendary"] on a sorcery is inert and the card would be castable with no legend in play, a one-sided wrath with no precondition. cast_only_during and the other card-level riders only gate timing, and alternative_cost's condition gates a price rather than the cast itself; there is no card-level cast condition key. The rest of the card is expressible once this lands: one exile op over {"zone": "battlefield", "controller": "any", "not_types": ["Land"], "not_supertypes": ["Legendary"], "count": "all"}
